data.name: Ghasiram
data.short_meaning: One who holds a bowl (Ghana + Siram)
data.long_meaning: The name Ghasiram is derived from Sanskrit words 'Ghana' meaning 'to hold' and 'Siram' meaning 'bowl'. This name is given to a boy who is believed to hold the wisdom and knowledge of the universe in his hands, like a bowl. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often depicted holding a bowl or a conch shell, symbolizing his nurturing and sustaining role in the universe.
